title: Art of Fighting
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, 10 characters, super gauge (MAME cheat database).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D), read at every frame ("fast") for the moves recognised at the stick (1.39); read the other way round if up and down show together

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

rounds.note: rounds won by player 1 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x90e6 Round Win, the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

rounds_p2.note: rounds won by player 2 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x91e6 Round oponent win, the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Fighting 101", from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2, to find with learn.bat (two-player game, score2=...)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x80 (MAME cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0x80 (MAME cheat database)

specials.note: special moves and supers of each fighter, shown under a human player's name (1.38): from the command list of MAME (command.dat 0.273, Fabricio Coroquer and AntoPISA), made by tools/command_dat.py
super_needs: Needs a amount of Spirit Gauge (%) and a FLASHING Life Bar
